content.title: MOTIVE v2 Exploratory Full-Profile ORF Prediction Rankings
content.description_html: Browse exploratory top-50 bidirectional rankings generated without retraining by applying two retained ORF GIN checkpoints to all 12,602 available JUMP ORF profiles and 115,790 compounds. model_pair_score is a checkpoint-specific ranking score, not a calibrated interaction probability; compare candidates only within the same query and checkpoint, and do not compare scores across checkpoints, directions, or with the benchmark model_ranking_score. is_connection_in_available_annotations refers to the available source annotation table, a different reference set from the benchmark flag, and is not biological validation. Results are exploratory and hub-dominated because connected and newly added isolated nodes were ranked together. This artifact contains no CRISPR inference. See the exact Zenodo record and the scientific provenance and limitations.

columns.gene_perturbation_type: Gene perturbation modality. The observed value is orf_overexpression.
columns.model_checkpoint_id: Retained checkpoint used for this ranking direction: 6d6658 or 5e30b1.
columns.checkpoint_validation_holdout: Entity type held out from training when validating the retained checkpoint: compounds_held_out_from_training or genes_held_out_from_training.
columns.model_architecture: Scoring architecture used by the checkpoint. The observed value is graph_isomorphism_network.
columns.graph_configuration: Graph edges used by the checkpoint. The observed value is compound_gene_edges_plus_compound_and_gene_similarity_edges.
columns.node_representation_strategy: Node inputs used by the checkpoint. The observed value is cell_painting_profile_features.
columns.query_entity_type: Whether the row is grouped under a gene or compound query.
columns.query_entity_identifier: Query identifier: gene symbol for gene queries or 14-character InChIKey connectivity block for compound queries.
columns.candidate_entity_type: Candidate type, which is opposite the query entity type.
columns.candidate_entity_identifier: Candidate identifier: gene symbol or 14-character InChIKey connectivity block according to candidate type.
columns.gene_symbol: Gene member of the gene-compound pair, independent of query direction.
columns.compound_inchikey14: 14-character InChIKey connectivity block for the compound member of the pair, independent of query direction.
columns.model_pair_score: Checkpoint-specific score used to rank candidates. It is not a calibrated interaction probability and is not directly comparable across checkpoints, directions, or with benchmark model_ranking_score; compare candidates only within the same query and checkpoint.
columns.candidate_rank_within_query: One-based rank from 1 through 50 within the query and checkpoint. This is the preferred field for within-checkpoint candidate comparison.
columns.number_of_candidates_scored_for_query: Total candidates scored before retaining the top 50 for that query and checkpoint: 115,790 compounds for gene queries or 12,602 genes for compound queries.
columns.is_connection_in_available_annotations: True only when the pair occurs in the available source annotation table. This uses a different reference set from the benchmark annotation flag, is not biological validation, and does not resolve the exploratory hub-dominated limitation.
